name: zoracleflux organization release provenance policy

required.ref_policy: refs/tags/v* for published releases; refs/heads/main only for rehearsals
required.github_artifact_attestation: required when repository plan/visibility supports it; otherwise record unavailable
required.attestation_availability: public repositories use GitHub's public Sigstore path; private repositories use GitHub's Sigstore path without public Rekor

verification.sigstore_python: sigstore verify github with exact repository, certificate identity, ref, and optional commit SHA

not_satisfied_by: a local key or a self-generated certificate
an identity regex that matches any repository in the organization
a workflow run from a pull request or unprotected branch
a GitHub organization name without repository and workflow constraints
